newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends a fraction firmer versus dollar.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends a fraction firmer versus dollar.

text.p: 1515 GMT - The Swiss franc ended very slightly firmer versus the U.S. dollar but was weaker against the mark compared with Friday's close.
The market was quiet for much of the day. One trader said that mark/Swiss was bid for a good deal of the session. But it saw profit-taking late in the day.
The trader said he expected the dollar to continue to move higher against the Swiss franc overnight, possibly targeting 1.2450 Swiss francs.
Separately, in a weekly market letter, CS analyst Michael Bernegger saw mark/Swiss trading higher near-term.

Bernegger saw the next key level on mark/Swiss at 82.18/82.20, which would represent a 61.8 percent retracement from the July/August decline. If the mark can break that level it could move "substantially higher" against the Swiss franc, he said. The mark moved briefly into that area on Monday, putting it back at mid-July highs versus the Swiss franc. * Dollar ends slightly lower at 1.2405/2415 Swiss francs compared with 1.2410/2420 at Friday's close. * Mark ends higher at 82.14/16 Swiss centimes compared with 82.04/07 at Friday's close. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
